_about: Merges of teams that pbleagues lists under DIFFERENT team ids, made on James's call (10 Oct 2026) from seasons + roster overlap. Applied after team-names.json. Every entry needs review by someone who knows the teams of the era. Overlap = share of the earlier team's players who appear on the later one; a continuing team keeps ~64% next season, ~37% three seasons later.

merges.evidence: Team Strange won the 2003 World Cup (1 event); Detroit Strange 2006-07 (10 events). 3-season gap. 4 of 15 players shared (27%).
All Americans 2003-04 (2 events); Philly Americans 2006-09 (19 events, won 2006 Texas + 2009 Phoenix). 2-season gap. 3 of 15 players shared (20%).
Avalanche 2004-05 (10 events, won 2004 Chicago); St. Louis Avalanche 2008 (3 events). 3-season gap. 2 of 31 players shared (6%).
